title.en: Nvidia becomes the first company in history to reach $4 trillion market capitalization
title.zhHans: Nvidia 成为历史上首家达到 4 万亿美元市值的公司

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA reached $4 trillion market cap in 2025 — the first company in history to achieve this milestone. How AI infrastructure demand drove NVIDIA’s unprecedented valuation.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2025 年达到 4 万亿美元市值——历史上首家实现这一里程碑的公司。AI 基础设施需求如何驱动了 NVIDIA 前所未有的估值。

summary.en: In July 2025, Nvidia became the first company in history to reach a $4 trillion market capitalization, driven by insatiable demand for its AI training and inference chips. The valuation had quadrupled since Nvidia surpassed $1 trillion in 2023 and made up approximately 7.3% of the S&P 500. By October 2025, Nvidia reached $5 trillion. The milestone symbolized AI's transformation from a technology trend into the dominant economic force of the 2020s.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 7 月，Nvidia 成为历史上首家达到 4 万亿美元市值的公司，由对其 AI 训练和推理芯片的巨大需求驱动。该估值自 2023 年 Nvidia 超过 1 万亿美元以来已翻了两番，约占标普 500 指数的 7.3%。到 2025 年 10 月，Nvidia 达到了 5 万亿美元。这一里程碑象征着 AI 从技术趋势转变为 2020 年代的主导经济力量。

narrative.en: Nvidia's $4 trillion milestone was the culmination of an extraordinary run. The company had been a graphics card maker for gamers; the AI boom transformed it into the engine of the global AI industry. Every major AI model — GPT-5, Gemini, Claude, Llama, DeepSeek — ran on Nvidia GPUs. The company's dominance was so complete that its products had become a national security concern, subject to export controls and trade restrictions. The $4T milestone in July 2025 was driven by several factors: the Stargate Project's $500B infrastructure commitment; DeepSeek R1's January selloff (which briefly dipped Nvidia's stock but was followed by a recovery as investors realized AI training still needed GPUs, just more efficiently); the ongoing expansion of AI inference workloads as models entered production; and Nvidia's product roadmap (Blackwell GPUs in volume production). Nvidia's rise was not without controversy. The stock's valuation was debated as a potential AI bubble — the company's P/E ratio exceeded 50. The $4T milestone also highlighted concentration risk: one company powering almost all of AI created a single point of failure for the industry. Geopolitically, Nvidia became a symbol of US AI supremacy and a target of Chinese criticism. The milestone marked the moment when AI's economic footprint became impossible to ignore: a single company in the AI supply chain was worth more than the entire stock markets of all but a handful of countries.
narrative.zhHans: Nvidia 的 4 万亿美元里程碑是一段非凡旅程的顶点。该公司曾是为游戏玩家制造显卡的公司；AI 热潮将其转变为全球 AI 产业的引擎。每个主要 AI 模型——GPT-5、Gemini、Claude、Llama、DeepSeek——都运行在 Nvidia GPU 上。该公司的统治地位如此彻底，以至于其产品已成为国家安全问题，受到出口管制和贸易限制。2025 年 7 月的 4 万亿美元里程碑由几个因素驱动：Stargate 计划的 5000 亿美元基础设施承诺；DeepSeek R1 的 1 月抛售（曾短暂压低 Nvidia 股价，但随后恢复，因为投资者意识到 AI 训练仍然需要 GPU，只是需要更高效）；随着模型投入生产，AI 推理工作负载的持续扩展；以及 Nvidia 的产品路线图（Blackwell GPU 进入量产）。Nvidia 的崛起并非没有争议。该股票的估值被争论为潜在的 AI 泡沫——公司的市盈率超过 50。4 万亿美元里程碑也突显了集中风险：一家公司为几乎所有 AI 提供动力，为行业创造了单点故障。地缘政治上，Nvidia 成为美国 AI 霸权的象征和中国批评的对象。这一里程碑标志着 AI 的经济足迹变得不可忽视的时刻：AI 供应链中的一家公司比除少数几个国家外的整个股票市场都有价值。

description.en: Nvidia became the first $4T company, making up 7.3% of S&P 500. Symbolized AI as the dominant economic force of the 2020s. Created unprecedented concentration risk — a single company powering almost all of AI infrastructure. Raised questions about AI bubble and overvaluation.
description.zhHans: Nvidia 成为首家 4 万亿美元公司，占标普 500 指数 7.3%。象征着 AI 作为 2020 年代主导经济力量。创造了前所未有的集中风险——单一公司为几乎所有 AI 基础设施提供动力。引发了关于 AI 泡沫和估值过高的质疑。

text.en: Nvidia became the first company in history to reach $4 trillion market capitalization in July 2025, reaching $5 trillion by October 2025.
